Quatro cenas 3D em pixel-art que você gi: Four pixel-art 3D scenes you spin with your mouse. Each one was written in code and is made of tens of thousands of Gaussian splats: tiny 3D blobs with color, shape and orientation.

Cada cena começa como código, vira uma n: Every scene starts as code, becomes a cloud of splats and is drawn as ellipses that form surfaces. You can redo it all in eight steps, starting from a ready-made template.

<span class=\"tag\">2 · SPLATS</span><st: 2 · SPLATSThe engine scatters pointsInk Studio covers every surface with splats: position, color, light and the shape of each blob. Here they are shrunk down to dots.

Cada splat aparece como um ponto de 2 pi: Each splat appears as a 2-pixel dot, without the ellipse the viewer normally draws. In version 1 you can see through the body; in version 2 the dots already form the surface. Notice the floor too, which got sparser on purpose.
De uma bola isolada para um sólido único: From a lone ball to a single solid: S.join('round', body, parts, { r: 0.14 }) samples the body and its seams in one pass.
De 7 para 13 espinhos, curvos (tubo de 3: From 7 to 13 spikes, curved (3-point tubes) and longer; ears with 4 points. All blended into the body.
Dedos próprios (tubos) dentro da junção;: Separate fingers (tubes) inside the blend; claws kept apart at res 0.022 to stay sharp.
A função <code>tex</code> passou de 3 pa: The tex function went from 3 to 6 tones: outline, brow shadow, gradient, ring, pupil and glint.
De uma grade de linhas para dentes calcu: From a grid of lines to teeth computed by a triangle wave: upper and lower rows offset by half a tooth, interlocking in a zigzag.
Sem relevo e sem as 9 pedras: o detalhe: No bumps and none of the 9 stones: the detail moved from the floor to the character.
Valores por parte são aproximados (separ: Per-part values are approximate (split by each splat’s position and color); the totals are exact.
<strong>Por que cresceu mais que o esper: Why it grew more than expected. res is the spacing between splats, so density grows with 1/res². Going from 0.045 to 0.026 would give about ×3; the measured ×4.4 is because the smooth blend also covers the seam curves between parts.
<strong>Onde o ganho se concentrou.</str: Where the gain concentrated. Spikes (×8) and arms (×6.6) had the biggest jump: besides finer sampling, they became more numerous and longer. The floor was the only place that lost splats.
<strong>O que não custou nenhum splat.</: What cost zero splats. The skin tone variation (mod), the gloss (gloss) and the painted face (tex) only change the color of splats that already exist.

Cada splat do Pikachu pertence a uma par: Every Pikachu splat belongs to one part: body, head, two ears, two arms, two feet or tail, decided by its position relative to each bone.
A cada quadro, cada parte gira em volta: Every frame, each part rotates around its own pivot, and each splat's shape rotates with it (C' = M·C·Mᵀ). The ears follow the head, and the head follows the body.
Raios e faíscas são splats extras, brilh: Bolts and sparks are extra splats, bright and almost paper-thin, flickering by alternating three groups.

Do zero até um cogumelo 3D que você gira: From zero to a 3D mushroom you spin in your browser. Then just swap the mushroom for whatever you imagine: the tower scenes were made exactly this way.
Como funciona, em três imagens: How it works, in three pictures
Confira se tem Node e Git: Check that you have Node and Git
Open a terminal and run both commands. Node must show v18 or higher. If either is missing, install it from nodejs.org and git-scm.com.
Baixe os dois projetos lado a lado: Download both projects side by side
O <strong>Ink Studio</strong> é o motor: Ink Studio is the engine that turns shapes into splats. Dimension Explorer is this project: the Splat Gallery, the 3D mode where scenes are explored, and the scene template. Both folders must sit inside the same folder.
Abra o modelo no navegador: Open the template in your browser
O modelo já vem pronto. Abra o arquivo <: The template comes ready. Open modelo/index.html in Chrome (double-clicking it in your file manager works too) and spin the mushroom with your mouse.
No macOS, use <code>open modelo/index.ht: On macOS, use open modelo/index.html; on Windows, start modelo\index.html.
@alt:O modelo: um cogumelo vermelho com: The template: a red mushroom with white spots on a grass disc
<strong>Apareceu “Não foi possível inici: Seeing “Não foi possível iniciar o WebGL” (WebGL could not start)? Your browser has 3D acceleration turned off. On Linux, open Chrome forcing software WebGL:
Copie o modelo para a sua cena: Copy the template into your scene
Nunca edite o modelo: faça uma cópia com: Never edit the template: make a copy named after your scene. Everything you will change lives in a single file, minha-cena/cena.js.
Abra <code>minha-cena/cena.js</code> no: Open minha-cena/cena.js in your editor. It is split into five commented parts (in Portuguese): palette, materials, shapes, S.bake() and camera. For a first test, change a color and a size:
Na paleta, troque <code>0xd2453f</code>: In the palette, replace 0xd2453f (light red) with 0x4f8ad8: the cap turns blue.
No caule, troque a altura <code>1.5</cod: In the stem, change the height 1.5 to 2.5 and the cap from 1.65 to 2.65: the mushroom grows.
Em <code>name: 'Cogumelo'</code>, coloqu: In name: 'Cogumelo', put your scene's name. It shows up as the page title.
Este comando roda o Ink Studio sobre o s: This command runs Ink Studio on your cena.js and writes scene-data.js, the file the viewer reads.
Abra <code>minha-cena/index.html</code>: Open minha-cena/index.html and reload with Ctrl+Shift+R. From here on the loop is always the same: edit cena.js → node export-scene.js → reload.
O Ink Studio também desenha a cena como: Ink Studio can also draw the scene as a pixel-art PNG. Change the angle with --yaw (turn, in radians) and --pitch (height).
Coloque na página inicial <span class=\": Add it to the home page OPTIONAL
No <code>index.html</code> da raiz, copi: In the root index.html, copy one of the <a class="scene"> cards and change the link, image and text. The preview image lives in thumbs/ at 720×480 pixels; a screenshot of your scene works.
Todas recebem um material (<code>{ r: [í: All of them take a material ({ r: [palette indices] }) and a res: the spacing between splats. Smaller is more detailed and heavier; 0.1 is a sketch, 0.03 is detailed.
Esfera ou elipse: copas, pedras, corpos: Sphere or ellipsoid: treetops, stones, bodies
Perfil girado em torno de Y: torres, cau: Profile spun around Y: towers, stems, cones
Tubo por uma lista de pontos, afinando:: Tapering tube through a list of points: trunks, branches, horns
Funde formas com curva suave (crie as pe: Blends shapes with a smooth curve (create the parts with { hold: true })
Truques usados nas cenas da torre: Tricks used in the tower scenes
Uma função <code>tex(x, y, z)</code> no: A tex(x, y, z) function in the material returns the color of each surface point. The mushroom spots are made this way.
Material com <code>em: true</code>: jane: A material with em: true: lit windows, lanterns.
Depois do <code>S.bake()</code>, milhare: After S.bake(), thousands of almost transparent golden splats with B.dab, all parallel to the sun direction, S.sun.
Splats de água com <code>B.disc(…, { k:: Water splats with B.disc(…, { k: 7 }) and pond in B.finish. The viewer reflects the scene only on them.
Renderiza 180 quadros com o Ink Studio m: Renders 180 frames with Ink Studio while moving the camera, then joins them with ffmpeg.
“Não encontrei o Ink Studio”: “Não encontrei o Ink Studio” (Ink Studio not found)
As pastas <code>shapeshift-labs-ink-stud: The shapeshift-labs-ink-studio and dimension-explorer folders must sit side by side (step 2). If they are elsewhere, run INK_STUDIO=/path/to/ink-studio node export-scene.js.
“Não foi possível iniciar o WebGL ou car: “Não foi possível iniciar o WebGL ou carregar a cena” (couldn’t start WebGL or load the scene)
Ou o WebGL está desligado (veja a nota d: Either WebGL is off (see the note in step 3), or scene-data.js was not generated: run node export-scene.js inside the scene folder.
Mudei o código e nada mudou: I changed the code and nothing changed
Gere de novo com <code>node export-scene: Generate again with node export-scene.js and reload with Ctrl+Shift+R, which skips the browser’s cached copy.
Aumente o <code>res</code> das formas gr: Increase the res of large shapes (for example, from 0.03 to 0.06). The splat total shows in the panel; up to about 100 thousand spins smoothly.
A mensagem mostra o número da linha de <: The message shows the line number in cena.js. It is almost always a missing comma, parenthesis or bracket.
